title: market.bar.closed.v1
description: Real transport contract (Kafka transport task; promoted from the architecture-freeze skeleton, docs/adr/007-shared-cross-service-contracts.md). ctrader-engine publishes this event once a candle closes (not yet implemented — that is a later task, docs/adr/004); analysis-engine consumes it to advance internal/marketdata's rolling history via internal/transport/kafka's market event adapter (internal/transport/kafka/handler.go). This is the PAYLOAD only — wrapped inside contracts/common/event-envelope-v1.schema.json's `payload` field, never published bare. Today's live equivalent is the bars:{SYMBOL}:{TF} Redis ZSET entry shape (app/analysis/ohlc_source.py, docs/redis-contract.md) — NOTE the deliberate difference: the Redis ZSET scores by bar-OPEN time, but this contract's own dedup/idempotency identity (canonical_symbol + timeframe + close_time, docs/transport/kafka.md's "Market bar identity" section) uses close_time instead, per source task §16's explicit instruction — a documented, intentional divergence from the existing Redis convention, not an oversight.

canonical_symbol.description: Canonical instrument identifier, e.g. "XAU" — matches market.Symbol / config's instruments.<symbol> key exactly. This, not broker_symbol, is analysis-engine's state identity (source task §26).

broker_symbol.description: The broker/feed's own symbol spelling (e.g. a cTrader-specific suffix), if it differs from canonical_symbol. Pure metadata — analysis logic must never branch on this field. Optional: omitted when the broker symbol and canonical symbol are identical.

timeframe.description: Matches market.Timeframe exactly — do not add a value here that Timeframe.go's minutesByTimeframe map doesn't also have.

open_time.description: Unix SECONDS of the bar's open — matches market.Candle.Time exactly (internal/market/candle.go), which is itself the same convention bars:{SYMBOL}:{TF}'s ZSET score already uses today (docs/redis-contract.md: "Score is the UTC bar-open epoch seconds").

close_time.description: Unix seconds of the bar's close — open_time + timeframe's own minute length * 60, exactly. Not independently stored by internal/market.Candle (which carries only open_time); included here because it is this contract's own bar-identity component (source task §16) and gives semantic validation something concrete to check (open_time + timeframe duration == close_time, docs/transport/kafka.md).
